description: This Java class defines an AmqpTarget that encapsulates a JMS Destination, representing messaging endpoints like queues or topics within an AMQP-based messaging system. It includes methods for creating destinations based on target address strings, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: AmqpTarget
classes.description: Immutable class representing an AMQP messaging target, encapsulating a JMS Destination (queue or topic). It provides static factory method to instantiate objects based on string addresses, and overrides standard Object methods for equality, hash, and string representation.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Creates an AmqpTarget instance from a string address, determining whether it is a topic or queue based on prefixes, and constructing the appropriate JMS Destination object.

methods.name: getJmsDestination
methods.description: Returns the JMS Destination associated with this AmqpTarget.
